textRuns.value: 1) First field is required and it defines chiclets.
2) Image field defines image that will be displayed inside a chiclet. It should contain URLs of images.
3) URLs that do not require authentication are supported only. URLs to local files are not supported.
4) Orientation of chiclets, columns and rows count, selection mode, visibility mode of disabled chiclets can be changed using formatting pane.
5) Text size, text color, height and width of chiclets can be changed using formatting pane.
6) Selected, unselected, disabled colors of chiclets and also background color, outline weight, outline style and outline color of chiclets can be changed using formatting pane.
7) There are options to show or hide header and to determine its title text, text size, font color, background color and transparency and also outline weight and outline color.
8) There are options to set image height, enable or disable image stretching and option to show image at bottom of a chiclet.
